apps.label: Amazon Shopping
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal Amazon Shopping Play entry in an eligible authorized store/device context; any supplied publisher package must first be complete and match package, current vendor signer and applicable version code.

sources.observed: The web tool returned DisabledError, not an observed HTTP 403 and not a download URL.
Amazon states ordinary Android Appstore support ended August 20, 2025; Fire tablet/TV distribution is separate.
Not accessible through this web tool; no complete same-package delivery was observed.

apps.specific_gap: No published complete Shopping APK URL has been verified. Amazon Appstore com.amazon.venezia is a different package and its ordinary Android service ended; substituting its old APK cannot update Shopping.

apps.label: TextNow
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal Play update path only if the authorized account, device and region qualify; obtain and verify the complete delivered APK/split set without bypassing the observed publisher refusal.

sources.observed: The normal page request returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; no retry or client alteration was attempted.
The publisher instructs Android updates through Google Play; Google account sign-in may be required.
The publisher says download/use is currently in North America and new registration is not available outside North America. This is not a measurement of the Pocket4 account or location.
The publisher states Android 9 or later; an acquired APK manifest is still required for candidate qualification.

apps.specific_gap: No complete same-package public APK endpoint was obtained. Account/region/store eligibility on the target is unknown, not an observed failure.

apps.label: United Airlines
apps.minimum_next_action: Use normal United Play delivery in an eligible authorized store context, or a publisher-supplied current URL. The legacy path or a recommendations page is insufficient for a download candidate.

sources.observed: Only a JavaScript-required shell was available to this text retrieval; no Android APK URL was exposed.
The official legacy path was not accessible through this web tool; its present download service is unverified.
The actual rendered page is recommendations, including 中国联合航空 and other apps, rather than a United same-package APK listing.

apps.specific_gap: No complete official United APK delivery chain was verified; the apparent Tencent route is demonstrably not the requested artifact.

apps.label: Uber
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal rider Play listing under valid account/device/region conditions and retain the actual delivered package set for full signature and compatibility verification.

sources.observed: The publisher provides Google Play and App Store buttons routed through rides.sng.link.
The web tool reported a non-retryable 500/access failure after the ordinary publisher redirect; no APK was returned.
The rider help page specifies Android 8 or later and Google Play installation. Driver-app requirements are a different product.

apps.specific_gap: No complete public APK URL or verified applicable version code. The baseline public version label is itself unknown.

apps.label: Marriott
apps.minimum_next_action: Run only the separately reviewed S44 two-HTML-page metadata probe once. Review a literal public delivery field if present; any later APK download needs a fixed bounded new request and complete same-package/current-vendor signature/version-code validation.

sources.observed: The actual official Chinese page Android button links to a.app.qq.com/o/simple.jsp?pkgname=com.marriott.mrt.
The same-package public market page displays version 11.15.0 and 231.37 MB. It also advertises the separate Tencent Appstore bootstrap; the latter is not a Marriott artifact.
The official market page displays 11.15.0, updated 2026-10-30, Marriott developer and 上海姜根酒店管理有限公司 operator, but the rendered download control exposes no complete APK URL.

apps.specific_gap: 11.15.0 on the China channel and 10.81.0 on the prior Play page are labels from different channels. Neither establishes a newer applicable candidate without the complete APK manifest, version code and signer.

apps.label: Hilton Honors
apps.minimum_next_action: Use that normal Play path in the authorized eligible environment, then verify the complete delivered APK/split set.

sources.observed: The official Android button follows hilton.app.link.
The normal publisher link presents Google Play; following that link reaches the exact com.hilton.android.hhonors Play listing.
Normal publisher-link traversal reaches the correct official Play package. This is not an APK delivery.

apps.specific_gap: No public complete publisher APK URL was found; store delivery/eligibility has not been observed.

apps.label: IHG
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal Google Play entry under valid account/device/region conditions; retain any complete delivery for candidate verification.

sources.observed: The current official Chinese support page is readable and expressly offers Android Google Play; no APK URL appears in retrieved content. This does not erase the earlier US-page access failure.

apps.specific_gap: No complete normal APK/split delivery was obtained.

apps.label: Hyatt
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal Hyatt Play listing in an eligible authorized store context. Complete artifact and current-version equivalence remain to be established.

sources.observed: This round retrieved the public benefits/member information page but no complete Android binary link; the previous HTTP 403 in baseline evidence is kept separately.
Publisher instructions identify App Store or Google Play for the World of Hyatt app.

apps.specific_gap: The same 26.9.0 public/historical version label does not show current installed bytes equal a complete applicable official release.

apps.label: National
apps.minimum_next_action: Follow the normal publisher app-store button in an authorized eligible environment, or request an actual publisher-supplied complete delivery URL; do not guess asset paths.

sources.observed: The normal official page is readable this round, with Download the App imagery; text retrieval exposes no complete APK URL. Earlier baseline access failures are not rewritten.

apps.specific_gap: Dynamic/image download control not resolved into an Android delivery URL; no complete APK.

apps.label: Hertz
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal publisher/Play channel under valid eligibility, or an actual publisher-provided complete URL; do not synthesize asset URLs.

sources.observed: The official page is readable and describes download, but retrieved content exposes no complete Android binary URL.

apps.specific_gap: No resolved complete APK or verified applicable store delivery.

sources.observed: The current official ANA app page links to the normal Google Play entry.

apps.minimum_next_action: Use ordinary Play delivery in the authorized eligible environment; no need to send a message to request a link.

sources.observed: The official page identifies Google Play for Android; an optional SMS route exists but no SMS was sent.
The current official page points to App Store or Google Play.

apps.specific_gap: No complete normal public APK URL found; actual store delivery unknown.

apps.label: TextFree
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the normal TextFree com.pinger.textfree Play channel with eligible authorized conditions; verify actual delivered artifacts.

sources.observed: textfree.us normally redirects here. The vendor page describes Android/Play availability and QR download controls, but no complete APK URL appears in retrieved content.

apps.specific_gap: No full APK. TextMe and other similarly named calling apps are not replacements for this package.

apps.label: StreetEasy
apps.minimum_next_action: Use the existing exact consumer StreetEasy Play package entry in the eligible authorized environment; do not substitute Agent Tools or the iOS artifact.

An older official page identifies Android Google Play; this is a normal channel reference, not current APK bytes.
